rules.description: Resolve from the project root to the execution cwd; selected target ancestors are not used as an alternate chain.
Try AGENTS.override.md then AGENTS.md and select the first readable, non-empty trimmed global instruction text.
For each project directory, select override, AGENTS.md, then configured fallback names; the first existing regular file wins before content is checked.
Apply selected project files in project-root-to-cwd order after the global instructions.
When marker configuration is unset, use the default [.git]; when no marker is found or the configured marker list is explicitly empty, use the cwd only.
Trim and drop empty fallback names and exact-name deduplicate them while preserving order.
Apply the default 32768-byte raw project-document budget.
Truncate raw bytes before lossy UTF-8 conversion; empty text consumes no budget.
Insert the documented global and project separators between instruction sections.
Follow symlinks for reads while preserving lexical discovery paths and cwd.
An explicit untrusted project excludes project content but retains global instructions.
AGENTS.md text is opaque; frontmatter, imports, and scope-like text do not alter applicability or execute imports.
Skills are available on demand and are not part of the automatic instruction chain.
Available Skills are represented separately from automatic AGENTS.md instructions.
Use non-empty CODEX_HOME exactly as provided, without whitespace trimming, requiring an existing directory and canonicalizing it; when unset, use <platform home>/.codex.
Search ancestors for the nearest configured marker, preserving nearest-match behavior.
File read options follow symlinks by default.
Global instructions and separators are excluded from the project document budget while project bytes are budgeted and truncated.
Project instruction reads apply the raw byte budget and truncation behavior, including empty-text handling.

assumptions: This profile freezes inspected source semantics at upstream revision b8c86376a258e55efc8e5ecfbabc21c16c07d814; the live documentation URL identifies the contract but is not runtime input.
AGENTS.md is a built-in candidate; the configured project fallback filename default is empty. Empty configured names are omitted and exact duplicates are removed.
MarkTurbo may deduplicate its display or Review projection while retaining occurrence order, raw provenance, and budget effects.

This profile resolves one local execution context with explicit effective configuration and trust only; it does not claim layered-config, sandbox, multi-environment, plugin, or complete harness fidelity.
Unsupported or malformed constructs are MarkTurbo product diagnostics, not upstream Codex discovery rules; content failures do not discard editable source text.
